name: Global Polynomial Expansion
description: Transforms the local binary constraint (s_u != s_v) into a global polynomial sum. By mathematically proving that the polynomial (s_u - s_v)^4 - 5(s_u - s_v)^2 achieves its minimum of -4 on the domain {1,2,3} if and only if s_u != s_v, we can enforce the coloring constraint globally by requiring the sum over all edges to equal -4m. To hide this, the sum is algebraically expanded and separated into vertex-specific intrinsic energies and edge-specific coupling energies. This prevents models from recognizing the binary constraints needed to build a constraint graph, forcing them into naive backtracking which will Time Limit Exceed without MRV heuristics.
